signature.name: VTask.ofEq
signature.type: {E : Type u_5} -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] -> {R' : Type u_12} -> [Ring R'] -> [Module R' E] -> (p q : Submodule R' E) -> (hpq : p = q) -> ↥p ≃ₗᵢ[R'] ↥q

conventions.statement: When p = q, the linear isometric equivalence VTask.ofEq p q hpq acts as the identity on elements: the underlying map sends each element of ↥p to the corresponding element of ↥q without changing its value or norm.
conventions.note: This follows from the fact that the map is constructed from LinearEquiv.ofEq, which is the identity reinterpreted along the equality proof.

facts.statement: ∀ {R' : Type*} {E : Type*} [Ring R'] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [Module R' E] (p q : Submodule R' E) (hpq : p = q), Isometry (VTask.ofEq p q hpq)
